role: cross-check only; the Brand Index is data/curated/index/brand_index_weekly.parquet (ADR-0040)
weekly_movement: 100% from the validated Lenovo parent-brand Google Trends proxy; survey values do not pin individual weeks
survey_role: quarterly orientation and display-scale calibration using the non-canonical GWI engagement/consideration composite

window_accounting.interpretation: overlap-rescaled window estimates; not independent repeated draws

excluded_from_core_index.product_queries: product demand is a companion pulse; it belongs to the experimental multi-signal construction rather than the headline salience index
excluded_from_core_index.price_queries: transaction/promotion intent, not broad brand salience
excluded_from_core_index.co_branded_queries: property-attributed outcomes; retain for sponsorship analysis
excluded_from_core_index.wikipedia_and_gdelt: did not show a stable positive relationship to the available GWI composite

caveat: This is a proxy-led salience index, not direct weekly survey measurement, a complete brand-equity measure, or a causal sponsorship estimate.
